ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio characterized by a bimodal distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels dominating the peduncle and central fluke regions, and 35% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large, contiguous white patch originating from the lateral tip extending inward; right lobe contains a smaller, more restricted white patch. Both patches are interrupted by low-intensity linear features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct acute V-shaped notch with a sharp convergence point dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks along the entire trailing edge boundary, appearing more jagged towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves extending from the median notch toward the posterior-pointing fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; three vertical streaks on the left lobe's white patch and four to five diagonal streaks on the right lobe's white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel linear scarring (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity pigmentation on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in white pigmentation coverage between the left and right lobes.
